context: Tests whether the agent records a Vaadin Flow application with a REST API next to it from the layer skills installed in the project (.claude/skills, each with references/layer.md): both the API and the UI layer are present, the UI is the integration layer, the use cases offered through only one channel are pointed to the **Layers:** line, and the hand-written docs/architecture.md is moved into docs/architecture/development.md with its content kept.

checklist.name: API and UI both present
checklist.description: The Layers table of docs/architecture/development.md names spring-rest and spring-rest-test for API and vaadin-flow-ui and vaadin-flow-ui-test for UI (not hilla-ui, which is installed too); neither layer is marked absent, and the combination is not reported as invalid

checklist.name: Other layers
checklist.description: The table names flyway-schema for Migration, jooq-persistence and jooq-persistence-test for Persistence, spring-service and spring-service-test for Service, and for E2E a Skill of '–' with vaadin-e2e-test as Test skill; no plugin is reported as still to install

checklist.name: Integration layer is the UI
checklist.description: Under the Layers table an Integration layer table's first row, UI, names the UI layer with vaadin-flow-ui-test — not the API — and an API row names the API layer with spring-rest-test for API-only use cases

checklist.name: Layers line explained
checklist.description: The report or the Development View says that a use case offered through only the UI or only the API names it in its **Layers:** line (e.g. FR-002 opening hours is UI only), and that without the line both layers are built

checklist.name: Document moved
checklist.description: docs/architecture.md no longer exists; docs/architecture/development.md keeps its conventions (feature packages, UTC times, RFC 9457 Problem Details)

checklist.name: Index written
checklist.description: docs/architecture/README.md exists and names development.md as the Development View; no logical, process, or physical view file is written

checklist.name: Nothing else changed
checklist.description: No Java source is written, pom.xml is unchanged, and docs/requirements.md is unchanged
